summary: Backend testing of Telegram scheduler features (payment reminders + /status command). All 4 pytest tests passed. Verified scheduler startup via supervisor logs, /status message format with real bills, 'Tudo em dia!' fallback when empty, reminder message format (Lembrete de Pagamento / 48h / date / amount), telegram_reminders dedup collection.

minor.issue: Log line shows 'Telegram scheduler started' twice at boot (2026-08-06 19:50:12 and 19:50:18) — suggests startup runs twice (likely uvicorn reload or startup event re-fired). Not functionally harmful but causes duplicate poll loops.
Two concurrent pollers (from duplicate startup) can race on getUpdates offset — may drop or double-process commands under load.

Uses today.replace(day=28)+timedelta(4) trick which works, but could be replaced by clearer month-end logic; also 'paid' filter uses date < today which mis-labels bills as paid — they may only be scheduled, not paid.

action_items: Investigate why 'Telegram scheduler started' logs twice on boot — ensure only one asyncio.create_task(run_telegram_scheduler) fires (guard against duplicate startup handlers or supervisor double-start).
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate scheduler startup — add an idempotency guard (module-level task singleton) so run_telegram_scheduler cannot be launched twice.

check_and_send_payment_reminders only checks exactly today+2 days; if the hourly scheduler misses a day (downtime), those reminders are lost forever. Consider a window (e.g. today+1..today+3) with per-bill dedup already in place.
poll_telegram_updates uses a module-level _last_update_id — not safe with two concurrent pollers.
_handle_resumo_command 'paid' label based on date < today is misleading.
test_credentials: n/a (functions called directly with motor db)
seed_data_creation: Tests create/cleanup TEST_ prefixed appointments and telegram_reminders records inside each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_telegram_scheduler.py covers /status (with bills + empty via FakeDB), reminder send + dedup, and no-bills-returns-0. It patches _send_message to avoid hitting real Telegram API. Duplicate 'Telegram scheduler started' log noted but not blocking.
